label: Three Lines Model Assessment
description: Evaluates the effectiveness and independence of an organization's three lines of defense. Identifies overlaps, gaps, and conflicts in governance structure.

claudeKnowledge.description: IIA Three Lines Model 2020, Basel Committee governance principles, EBA internal governance guidelines

guidedInputs.label: Institution and governance structure
guidedInputs.description: Describe the institution, its size, regulatory status, and current governance structure.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Mid-sized Nordic bank (€8B total assets, ECB less-significant institution). 1st line: Business units and Risk Management function embedded in business. 2nd line: Central Risk function, Compliance, Legal. 3rd line: Internal Audit (10 FTEs, reports to Audit Committee).

guidedInputs.label: Observations and evidence to assess
guidedInputs.description: What have you observed about how the three lines function? Include specific examples of gaps, overlaps, or conflicts.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Compliance function both sets AML policy AND tests compliance with it. Internal Audit reports administratively to CFO, not directly to Audit Committee. 1st line risk managers are included in 2nd line risk committee. 2nd line approves individual transactions in the credit process...
